shapeSummary: Flat 18-tooth 8mm-pitch (05B) sprocket, 49.2mm OD, 46.1mm pitch diameter, 2.4mm thick, with a 14mm through bore and four 4mm through holes on a 16mm square pattern. The disc axis runs along Y, with the bottom face at Y=0 and the top at Y=2.4. It is centered in X and Z.
warnings: Tooth profile is simplified: round 5.4mm roller seats at the pitch radius with a straight flared opening to the OD. It is not a true ANSI/ISO 05B tooth form.
The four unlabeled slotted holes on the X and Z axes (about 11.3mm radius) are omitted because they are not dimensioned.
The 24mm dimension is ambiguous and was not used.
The tooth gaps are phased with one gap on the +X axis, and the drawing's phase may differ.
The 5.4mm roller seat is assumed, not stated in the drawing.
